finer1971_egg_pc@1.preparation: Fraction II of sonicated egg-yolk lecithin. External manganese broadened the solvent-accessible choline proton signal.
finer1971_egg_pc@1.geometry_source: The authors took radius and thickness from Huang (1969), DOI 10.1021/bi00829a048. They reported an expected inner fraction of 0.265.
finer1971_egg_pc@1.uncertainty: No error reported on the protected fraction. The cited geometry is external to the NMR sample.

huang1978_egg_pc@1.preparation: Homogeneous egg phosphatidylcholine vesicles. The group combined its earlier phosphorus NMR and hydrodynamic measurements.
huang1978_egg_pc@1.geometry_source: The authors subtracted a 6 Å hydration layer from the 105 Å hydrodynamic radius and assumed equal molecular volumes. Total count was inferred from mass.
huang1978_egg_pc@1.uncertainty: Table 1 input errors were at most 5% according to the authors. Table 2 gives rounded inferences without propagated intervals.

kucerka2011_popc_temperature@1.locator: Table 1, pure POPC at 30 and 50 °C, with Eq. 2
kucerka2011_popc_temperature@1.measurement: Area inferred from joint neutron and X-ray scattering. The 30 °C entry is also the existing Cells calibration.

leftin2014_popc_temperature@1.locator: Table 1, pure POPC, carbon-13 NMR columns
leftin2014_popc_temperature@1.measurement: Molecular areas inferred from chain order using the mean-torque model. The SDs propagate repeated dipolar-coupling measurements.
